user_story: As a community member watching a video or live stream, I want tapping the player surface to reveal controls rather than toggle pause, so that I don't accidentally interrupt playback during normal viewing.
preconditions: User is viewing a video post or live stream post on any scoped surface
entry_points: A. Video or live stream is playing inline in any feed (global, user, community, event discussion)
B. Video or live stream is open in a media gallery or fullscreen view
last_synced: 2026-07-06 (Jira updated 17:02 — Platforms section added to description)

not_supported: Desktop — no behaviour change; only a small UI design change (button size), per PM Ghita 2026-07-06

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Tap playing player → controls overlay appears, playback continues
given: A video or live stream is playing
acceptance_criteria.when: The user taps anywhere on the player surface
then: Playback continues uninterrupted — the video or stream does not pause

clarifications_needed.observation: Jira comment thread (Pidshapar → Chayanit, 2026-07-03): on web, the recorded-live-stream viewer and the video viewer use the same video component, but a 'Live' live stream uses a different component
clarifications_needed.consequence: Tap-to-reveal behaviour verified on 'video' does not automatically cover a 'Live' live stream; the two render paths differ and must be tested separately
clarifications_needed.question: Confirm tap-to-reveal AC applies identically across (a) video, (b) recorded live stream, (c) 'Live' live stream, given 'Live' uses a different component
clarifications_needed.resolution: Jira 2026-07-03: recorded live stream + video share one component (web) — treat 'video' AC coverage as including recorded live streams; 'Live' live stream differs and must be covered separately.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Tap outside pause button while overlay visible → overlay dismisses, playback continues
acceptance_criteria.when: The user taps anywhere on the player surface outside the central pause/play button

acceptance_criteria.scenario: No action after overlay appears → overlay auto-dismisses after timeout
acceptance_criteria.when: The user takes no further action
then: The overlay auto-dismisses after a short timeout (1 second)

clarifications_needed.observation: PRD says '~1 second' but comment says 'assume 3s'
clarifications_needed.consequence: Inconsistent timeout causes misaligned test expectations across platforms
clarifications_needed.question: What is the confirmed auto-dismiss timeout value?
clarifications_needed.resolution: Jira updated 2026-06-30: description now explicitly states '1 second'. No longer ambiguous.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Tap pause button while playing → playback pauses, icon changes
given: A video or live stream is playing
acceptance_criteria.when: The user taps the central pause/play button
then: The button icon switches from pause to play

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Tap play button while paused → resumes from exact position, icon changes
given: A video or live stream is paused
acceptance_criteria.when: The user taps the central play button (controls visible, or re-summoned by a tap)
then: Playback resumes from the exact position at which it was paused
The button icon switches from play to pause

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Behavior is identical across all in-scope surfaces
given: Any in-scope surface (global feed, user feed, community feed, event discussion feed, media gallery)
acceptance_criteria.when: The user taps the player surface
then: The behaviour described above is identical regardless of surface
